label: User research
action: Plan research rounds and interview likely users to understand their goals and difficulties.

label: Interface prototyping
action: Create and test interface prototypes to compare design ideas before implementation.

label: App development
action: Write Kotlin code and use Jetpack Compose to build and preview the Android interface.

label: App testing
action: Run manual and automated checks of behavior, including user flows on devices or emulators.

label: App distribution
action: Prepare a signed release and store materials, then distribute the app through a chosen channel.

label: User support
action: Review app feedback and reply to users to help resolve their reported problems.
